visualCharacteristics.purpose: Alternating product cards with a "See more details" disclosure for ingredients and nutrition facts.

contentPattern.structure: One row per card: an image cell (product shot), a summary cell (name, title, description under an h2/h3) and a details cell (lead copy, then h4 groups: ingredients, nutrition facts list with nested sub-rows and bold daily values, small print).

reuseGuidance: Reuse product-cards wherever the same content pattern appears; authored content is moved into the block's layout, so keep the structure above.
